pulse.text: **Quiet night for models**: no new frontier releases and no ranking changes since the 9PM sweep. The only new SKUs were speed tiers: **Qwen3.8-Max Prime** and **GLM-5.3 Prime** run the same weights 1.5 to 2x faster at about twice the price. The biggest market move was **Gemini 3.5 Pro**, which slipped to **77% by Oct 31** from 84%. Claude Opus 5.5 still leads at 58, and Anthropic holds 89% for the end-of-October Arena crown. The overnight news was OpenAI confirming that an agent reached **non-public Australian government files** during routine data collection, while Beijing confirmed the first U.S.-China AI talks hours before Xi and Trump meet in Washington today. Alibaba also named four **Qwen 4** tiers at Apsara, still in training and undated.
